issue_context.summary: Keyboard Manager shortcut remaps can stop together after Quick Accent false activations; a narrowly targeted Quick Accent key-up fix has been merged, but the issue was reopened because maintainers believe it covered only part of the symptom.
known_information: A contributor supplied deterministic 0.99.1/0.100.2 reproduction, keyboard-state evidence, current-source analysis, and patched-build validation.
PR 49644, 'Forward key-up after false activation', was merged and is linked as the closing pull request.
A maintainer immediately reopened the issue stating that only part of the bug was fixed.
inferences: Any remaining failure after a build containing PR 49644 is likely a second trigger and should not be assigned the already-fixed swallowed-key-up root cause without a new reproduction.

comment.body:
Thanks for the deterministic Quick Accent trace and for validating the key-up fix that became PR #49644. The issue was reopened because that change was believed to cover only part of the failure, but the thread does not yet contain a post-fix trigger.

**Needed**
1. Please retest on the latest stable release and provide the exact PowerToys version from About.
2. If remaps still stop, please list the shortest key sequence, enabled modules, remap, elapsed time, and whether lock/unlock or toggling Keyboard Manager restores operation.

This will separate the merged Quick Accent false-start bug from the remaining trigger and prevent reopening the already-fixed path.
